description: R function -> TS symbol -> shared test cases. Filled in as port groups land; tools/check-parity-map.ts gates npm publishes (tag builds only) on completeness of the 11 public functions.

deviations: sparse without gcRate in rates throws (R messages and returns corrupt output)
ablineType "non": R yields NULL ab_lines; TS computes the free-mode ab-line (InputLayout.abLine is non-nullable)
band-boundary clipping via exact scanline in the rotated frame (equivalent to st_intersection on axis-aligned strips); @turf/union//difference for headland dissolve/subtract
plot_id can repeat within a strip split by boundary holes (R restarts per piece) — matches R behavior, contradicts naive key uniqueness
seedable splitmix32 RNG instead of R RNG: randomized designs verified by properties, not sequences (design D4)
sparse design ported from source semantics — the R 0.1.3 assign branch is broken with modern data.table (verified), no execution parity possible
partial-design flow only (one dosed + one geometry-only input); R also supports conditioning a third input on a fully-dosed two-input design — not ported (spec: périmètre réduit)
reuses the stored rate_rank instead of recomputing .GRP by rate (numbering-only difference)
targets the named input; R's input_name filter is a tautology and always modifies the first input
unknown strip/plot targets throw ValidationError; R silently no-ops
plot mode requires strictly ascending plotIds; R positionally mis-assigns matrix rows otherwise
ha_strip_id numbered sequentially from the guidance line (provable same ordering; R anchors on a float-sensitive field centroid) — parity asserted on row content
no ggplot output: tabular overlap data only
spec-level 1e-6 parity via R-precomputed alignment-fragments.json; live turf join asserted at 1e-3 (turf vs GEOS area noise)
single-input design throws an explicit ValidationError; R crashes accidentally (cor_input never assigned)
spec-level 1e-6 parity via R-precomputed ortho-fragments.json; live turf join asserted at 1e-3
no ggplot output: correlations/summary tables only; public spatialJoin utility exposes the fragments

raster layers supported via GeoTIFF (readGeoTiffRaster + extractRasterMeans, terra::extract fun=mean cell-center semantics, north-up and south-up); raster CRS must be WGS84 or UTM-reprojectable, unknown EPSG throws
character/factor variables return per-class rate mean/sd (factorSummaries field, additive to the result shape)
zip layout uses one subdirectory per input (collision-free across formats); R writes flat prefixed filenames — content parity verified against R exports
isoxml (beta) has no R counterpart: no field-boundary geometry under PFD, no guidance lines; DDI by unit family documented in docs/isoxml-units.md
input names are validated against path traversal (ExportError); R writes any name verbatim
abline_type "none" excluded (crashes upstream R 0.1.3)
throws on unknown pairs; R returns an empty vector
liters/unknown-combo/metric-kg-only paths return sane values; R returns numeric(0) (dead factor-1 fallback)
getLcm throws when maxPlotWidth < max(widths); R's seq() crashes there anyway
